meanings.ex: The struggling airline had to trim the workforce to stay solvent.
meanings.tr: 경영난에 시달리던 그 항공사는 지급 능력을 유지하기 위해 인력을 감축해야 했다.

meanings.ex: The new CEO orchestrated a remarkable turnaround of the failing company.

words.tip: Part 5: turnaround(명사)와 turn around(동사구) 구분 주의

meanings.ex: The warehouse reduced its order turnaround time by implementing an automated picking and packing system.
meanings.tr: 그 창고는 자동화된 피킹 및 포장 시스템을 도입해 주문 처리 소요 시간을 단축했다.

quick turnaround time 빠른 처리 시간

meanings.ex: Organizers were pleased with the unexpectedly high turnout at the product launch event.

colloc: unexpectedly high turnout 예상외로 높은 참석자 수

meanings.ex: The board reached a unanimous decision to approve the acquisition.

meanings.ex: The board unanimously approved the proposed merger with the rival firm.

meanings.ex: Under the terms of the warranty, defective parts will be replaced free of charge.

meanings.ex: The factory will undergo renovation to increase production capacity.

meanings.ex: The hiring manager rejected several applicants deemed underqualified for the senior compliance role.

meanings.ex: The report underscores the need for stricter quality control.

meanings.ex: The contractor agreed to undertake the renovation despite the tight construction schedule.

meanings.ex: The firm reported unprecedented growth in overseas markets following the trade agreement.

meanings.ex: Trained sales staff are encouraged to upsell premium warranties whenever customers purchase electronics.

meanings.ex: An unexpected upsurge in orders overwhelmed the company's fulfillment capacity.

meanings.ex: There is a vacancy in the marketing department for a new manager.

meanings.ex: Tenants must vacate the premises by the end of the month.

meanings.ex: The investment bank revised its valuation of the startup downward after reviewing the disappointing quarterly earnings report

meanings.ex: Failure to meet vendor compliance standards, including proper labeling and packaging, can result in shipment rejection at the distribution center.

meanings.ex: The inspector cited inadequate ventilation as a violation of the workplace safety code

ventilation and safety 환기 및 안전

meanings.ex: The tech startup secured venture capital funding to accelerate product development.

meanings.ex: The new software is versatile enough to handle both accounting and inventory management.

meanings.ex: Thorough vetting of executive candidates includes verifying prior compensation and disciplinary records.

meanings.ex: Management concluded that outsourcing logistics was the most viable option.

meanings.ex: Any amendment not approved in writing by the board shall be deemed null and void.

meanings.ex: Guests will receive a voucher for a free meal at the restaurant.

meanings.ex: Unsold inventory left in storage beyond the agreed period incurs an additional warehousing fee charged monthly.

meanings.ex: Whereas the vendor failed to meet the delivery schedule, the client is entitled to invoke the penalty clause.

meanings.ex: With regard to the proposed merger, the board requested further financial analysis.

meanings.ex: The employer will withhold a portion of each paycheck for taxes.

meanings.ex: Without further ado, let's move on to the quarterly financial review.

meanings.ex: The retailer secured a short-term loan to bolster working capital during the holiday season.

meanings.ex: Corporate bonds currently offer a higher yield than government-issued securities.

meanings.ex: The developer had to apply for a zoning variance before converting the warehouse into office space
